_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Repair Parts Report
summary: The Repair Parts Report provides the Government with information needed to monitor repairs and delivery of repaired parts.
use_relationship:
The Repair Parts Report will provide the Government with the information needed to monitor repairs and delivery of repaired parts.
This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Repair Parts Report shall be in the Contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Report shall contain a list of parts undergoing repair and it shall also identify the following information for each part repaired:

children.title: Status of repairs shall be identified as applicable
Actual shipping date for the completed part
Description of evaluations conducted, failure modes determined and repairs affected
children.content: The Report shall contain a description of evaluations conducted, failure modes determined and repairs affected.

children.title: Cumulative cost of evaluation and repair
children.content: The Report shall contain cumulative cost of evaluation and repair, to reflect the total repair cost for completed repairs.

children.title: Ceiling amount for the Contract Line Item Number (CLIN).
Contract Modification number on which the funded amount is based.
Cumulative expenditure amount by CLIN as of the report date.
Total monthly expenditure amount for that month, including labor, a list of labor categories, labor hours, and fully burdened labor rates.
A list of the items, quantity, unit price, and total price for materials.
Any other expenditures being directly charged to the CLIN.
